name: flatcitybuf
description: Native C++17 reader and writer for FlatCityBuf, a cloud-optimized binary encoding of CityJSON.

FlatCityBuf stores CityJSON semantics in FlatBuffers alongside a packed Hilbert R-tree for spatial queries and a static B+tree for attribute queries, so a client can fetch only the bytes it needs - including over HTTP range requests.

curl.description: HTTP range-request reader backed by libcurl
